title: Secret Message Copy
engine: custom DOM and Canvas copying runtime with shared QLOBE screens, audio, narration, timing, celebration, and debug modules
shareTitle: Secret Message Copy - Trace, Remember, Deliver!
description: Help a watercolor owl courier copy picture codes, trace short secret words, and remember moon messages before delivering each envelope.
learningGoals: Practice left-to-right visual copying with short picture sequences
Build uppercase letter formation and fine-motor control through guided tracing
Exercise visual working memory with three- and four-symbol codes
interactionModel: choose one of three large illustrated envelopes, tap matching raster stamps from left to right or trace uppercase letters from a golden start dot, then send the finished message
feedbackModel: the next slot and guide glow, earned progress is never removed, misses reveal a gentle clue without penalty, and each completed copy reaches an authored owl-courier delivery tableau with recorded praise

modes.title: Picture Code
modes.skill: left-to-right copying of three- to five-symbol visible sequences

modes.title: Secret Words
modes.skill: guided uppercase formation for SUN, CAT, MAP, and OWL

modes.title: Moon Memory
modes.skill: recall and reproduction of hidden three- and four-symbol sequences

credits: Original Watercolor / Storybook raster artwork produced with OpenAI GPT Image 2 and prepared with the QLOBE asset cutting pipeline; narration produced through the approved local voice workflow with verified neural fallback after the Qwen service failed.
